fields.Description: Analogue drive. Carries signal data for storing, further processing or selling.
fields.Info: Drives can be put into drive slots at different machines in the Signal Processing & Research Room at Alpha Root Base to store and transfer Signals . At 06:00 , a single empty Drive will be sent to the base via the Delivery drone as part of the daily delivery. Look at the color of the indicator lights to tell what kind of Signal is stored inside.

fields.Description: A default box for drives. Used to store drives and sell them off.
fields.Info: Drive boxes are primarily used for completing Dr. Bao's daily tasks, but can also be used for selling signals independently. Drive boxes can store up to 8 Drives. If no Drive boxes exist in a save, one will be sent at 06:00 along with the daily delivery.

fields.Description: A standard battery. Used in most flashlights and other small electronics
fields.Info: Hold Batteries and press RMB (Rotate object keybind) to insert them into Flashlights , or select the "Use" option from their context menus. Use the "Discharge Flashlight" button in your inventory menu to remove them.

fields.Description: A gas can, stores fuel for the vehicle. The gas amount can be transferred between the gas cans and gas tanks: LMB - pour gas into RMB - take gas from Can be recycled into metal
fields.Info: Gas cans store up to 100 units of Fuel and can be used to refuel the ATV and Lanterns . They can explode if they take enough damage.

fields.Description: Low quality camera. Low frame rate, noisy and dark.
fields.Info: Surveillance devices that can be accessed through the Main computer after being mounted on a surface and activated. They come equipped with lights, infrared sensors, and zoom capability.

fields.Selling price: Medium quality camera. Better frame rate, but grayscale.
Good quality camera. Good frame rate, supports colors.

fields.Description: A notepad, contains papers that can be torn off.
fields.Info: Contains 12 pages that each act as a Paper sheet . Can be used as a more efficient way to carry around multiple Paper sheets.

fields.Description: A paper sheet. Used to make satellite reports and name tags.
fields.Info: Sheets of paper that can be used for creating nametags, drawing, and crafting. Keyboard shortcuts work when typing on them.

fields.Description: A below average quality mattress. 50% stamina restoration
fields.Info: Allows the player to sleep in any location when unrolled on the ground. Restores stamina at 50% the normal rate (100% when placed in a bedframe).

fields.Description: A standard blue sleeping bag. Allows you to sleep wherever you like. 80% stamina restoration
fields.Info: Allows the player to sleep in any location when unrolled on the ground. Restores stamina at 80% the normal rate.

fields.Description: A high quality thick sleeping bag. 90% stamina restoration
fields.Info: Allows the player to sleep in any location when unrolled on the ground. Restores stamina at 90% the normal rate.

fields.Description: A unique sleeping bag. 110% stamina restoration
fields.Info: Allows the player to sleep in any location when unrolled on the ground. Restores stamina at 110% the normal rate.

fields.Description: Heals by 10%
fields.Info: Items that heal the player for varying amounts. They cannot stop bleeding or increase Max health if lowered.

fields.Description: Heals by 20%
Heals by 30%
Drains the stamina meter and makes you fall asleep better
fields.Info: Increases stamina drain rate by approximately ~100% when used. The effect lasts roughly ~70 real-world seconds.

fields.Description: Restores max health value
fields.Info: Restores the Max health of the player. Does not restore the player's regular Health value.

fields.Description: A first aid pack, contains a bunch of pills, a bandage, and suppliments
fields.Info: Unpacks into an assortment of healing items.

fields.Description: A roll of cheap toilet paper.
fields.Info: Holds 24 sheets of toilet paper. Useful for Crafting .

fields.Description: RMB - ping the ATV to show its aproximate location
fields.Info: Used to remotely locate the ATV by holding and pressing RMB .

fields.Description: A cooking book contains the list of recipes you can cook
fields.Info: Contains useful information on recipes and some hints to help navigate the cooking mechanics.

fields.Description: A compass - part of a standart equipment, when equipped - displays a compass on the screen that can be used to point at different points of interests from the console
fields.Info: Can be used to target different locations from a console to navigate the map easier. When equipped, the red arrow points towards whichever location has been targeted.

fields.Description: A flashlight - part of standart equipment, self explanatory
fields.Info: Use the Discharge Flashlight button in the inventory to remove batteries. Holding F (Flashlight keybind) will focus or unfocus the flashlight's beam.

fields.Description: Glasses - part of a standart equipment. [Velma mode ONLY] removes the screen blur when equipped, can be knocked off if player ragdolls and hits on the head hard enough
fields.Info: Glasses have no effect on gameplay unless the "Velma mode" setting is enabled. A Gaussian blur effect is applied to the screen if players aren't wearing glasses while it's enabled.

fields.Description: This flashlight can be cranked and generate the energy for its internal battery. Weaker than a regular flashlight, but better than nothing. How to use: Hold ALT and click RMB to recharge it RMB to equip
fields.Info: An alternative to the flashlight that contains a renewable power source. Hold Left Alt (Alt keybind) and hold or rapidly press RMB (Rotate keybind) to charge it.

fields.Description: Stops blood loss
fields.Info: Immediately stops bleeding and restores 10 Health. Can only be used if actively bleeding.

fields.Description: Big flashlight is twice as powerful and twice as efficient: brighter, illuminates further, and uses less battery power
fields.Info: An alternative to the flashlight with a larger beam, batteries last for 4 times as long.

fields.Description: Data tape used to gather runtime information from the system
A box that holds data tapes for more convenient handling.
Covers the data tape case
A standard ASO floppy disc. Specifically designed to hold server data only. Has a small limited amount of read-writes.
A standard ASO floppy disc. Specifically designed to hold server data only. Has a small limited amount of read-writes.
A standard ASO floppy disc. Specifically designed to hold server data only. Has a small limited amount of read-writes.
A special duty drive for storing specific type of information.
A standard ASO floppy disc. With pre-installed software for server repairs. Data blocks used to give "health" to servers when they get damaged, preventing them from going down.
Can hold up to 15 floppy discs
A fuse prevents machinery from breaking down. Can be used on: - Radio tower - Coordinate radars

fields.Food: A default hamburger. Made of meat scraps like the rest of the burgers
A food box, essential for keeping yourself alive for some time.
"Meal Ready to Eat" enough to sustain yourself for a long period of time.
A pack of large shrimps. The greatest delicacy in the universe.
A coffee chocolate bar, provides a small boost of energy.
The promised cake.
A chocolate chip cookie. Nice and tasty.
A pizza box with pizza inside. Nutritious and fun to eat.
A regular beef taco. Crunchy and tasty.
real swenden meetbola
tomblerones.
A regular pumpkin, nothing spooky.
A regular chicken nugget.
A sweet bun.
A regular banana, great snack.
A bag of microwave popcorn. Put the bag inside the microwave and wait for it to pop
A big piece of high quality medium-hard cheese
A loaf of bread, can be eaten or chopped into pieces"
A regular cucumber, can be eaten or chopped into pieces
A lemon, can be eaten or chopped into pieces. Has high food tolerance
A mango, can be eaten or chopped into pieces
An orange, can be eaten or chopped into pieces
A pineapple, cannot be eaten by itself but it can be chopped into pieces
A big tomato, can be eaten or chopped into pieces
A big watermelon, cannot be eaten by itself but it can be chopped into pieces
A bottle of beer. Hold it and press RMB to open the bottle. RMB to drink
fronch
N/A
A raw beef steak. Can be cut into beef patties

fields.Description: N/A
fields.Food: N/A

fields.Description: N/A
fields.Food: A wooden rolling pin, used to flatten the dough

fields.Description: N/A
fields.Food: A bread mold, used to cook bread

fields.Description: N/A
fields.Food: Metalli baking tray, used to bake foods such as cookies
A bottle of regular milk

fields.Description: N/A
fields.Food: A bag of sugar

fields.Description: N/A
fields.Food: Allows to grab and hold onto a hot food and burning objects

fields.Description: "A familiar crowbar that can be equipped, dealing medium amounts of damage and featuring a medium attack speed."
fields.Info: One of the best tools for breaking things. Deals 10 damage on hit with a fast swing rate.

fields.Description: "A portable digital map. Shows player coordinates and location, satellites locations, and height map of the area."
fields.Info: Shows the coordinates of the tool, not the player. Also displays enabled beacons.

fields.Description: "Seems to be an ordinary rock, could be useful for breaking things."
fields.Info: To break things, use the stone as a prop, not as a tool. Does only two damage when held in the hand.

fields.Description: "A beacon, displays a waypoint on the digital map and the built-in ATV minimap."
fields.Info: If radar colors are enabled, beacons appear as purple on the radar.

fields.Description: "A box with tools. Can be used to fix the ATV."
fields.Info: To use, either touch the ATV with the toolbox or (while holding the toolbox) press LMB on the ATV. Can also be used to fix broken pipes in the base's basement. The selling price does not change even after all ten uses have been consumed.

fields.Description: "A digital camera. Can be used to take photos and transfer them to a computer."
fields.Info: Once a photo is taken, it will be present in the Photos tab of the computer. From there you can delete it, export it to the VotV folder as a jpg, or print it, if you own a Fax/printer from the Machines tab of the Store.

fields.Description: "Hooks with a rope. Used to hook two objects."
fields.Info: Extremely durable. The first time you press the LMB to throw the first hook, which is immediately attached to the object. The second time - attach the hook to another object. RMB returns the hook The mouse wheel changes the length of the hook. You can use this hook as a grappling hook.

fields.Description: "A metal detector. Beeps if an object underground is nearby."
fields.Info: To be used in conjunction with a Shovel. The Shovel can only be found by exploring.

fields.Description: "A password changer for the keypads. Remember to change both keypads on either side of the door."
fields.Info: Can be used to change the password to the inner locked door to the bunker, as a method of gaining entry. Will not work on the first door.

fields.Description: "Nails stuff together. Put nails in a container box for a hammer to use them."
fields.Info: To use the hammer to place a nail, nails must be inside the player inventory. They can also be inside a container within the inventory.

fields.Description: "Repels roaches."
fields.Info: Makes roaches move away from the area affected by it, of around 1.5 meters. Good for keeping roaches away from food on the floor, or from a specific area.

fields.Description: "An ordinary lighter. Ignites stuff."
fields.Info: Use right click to open lighter and left click to use flame to ignite an object. Fire will spread between objects, or to the player, damaging them. Has a limited amount of uses.

fields.Description: "A simple fire extinguisher, comes in handy when things get "hot"."
fields.Info: Left click to shoot a stream of extinguisher to put out fire. Fire extinguishers will burst and fly around if hit hard enough.

fields.Description: "A handheld thermometer. LMB to check the food temperature, or health of an object. RMB to check your own health"
fields.Info: Left clicking on food items will report their temperature, and left clicking on breakable props will give their current health. Right clicking reports on your current health as well as your current maximum health.

fields.Description: "A ball of red string, connects two points or objects together. Breaks when enough force is applied."
fields.Info: Similar to the Hook, string will connect objects together, but is overall far more flimsy and more decorative in nature. Infinite uses.

fields.Description: "A pencil, used to draw on paper. Pick it up, then right click on an empty paper sheet."
fields.Info: Despite the item description, left click is actually the control to draw on a piece of paper. This will open a menu where left click can be used to draw, right click is used to erase, the color can be changed in the top left (sandbox only), you can crumple up a piece of paper using the "Destroy" button, and use the "Export" button to export your image to the VotV file folder, similar to the Digital camera.

fields.Description: "A one meter long wooden ruler. Useful for macro measurement."
fields.Info: Meter long ruler.

fields.Description: "Measuring tape returns the length between two points, hold LMB on any surface, then release LMB on any other surface and get the length between these two points"
fields.Info: Hold right click between two points to determine the distance between the two. Best tool for measuring distance.

fields.Description: "Using workbench you can craft items, put items on top of it, then look at the edge of the table, use Mouse Wheel to select the craft option, and press E to craft. Blueprint unlocks craft that normally inaccessible, to use the blueprint - simply put it on top of the table along with the items"
fields.Info: Large item used to craft objects, found in the garage of the Base upon starting the game. Can be used to turn trash pieces and objects into scrap and making crafting recipes. To use, place materials on the table, stand back and aim cursor at the top of the table, then use the E key (Grab keybind) to select a craft, or aim cursor at the botton of workbench, hold E key (Grab keybind) open the slect menu, select Crafting to select a craft.

fields.Description: "A box of pins."
fields.Info: Right click to place a small red pushpin. Pins placed on the map will be semi-transparent.

fields.Description: "Can opener opens canned food, look at the canned food and press LMB"
fields.Info: Used to open Canned Food , which are found in supply boxes, around the map, and underground.

fields.Description: "Kitchen knife chops food such as fruits, fish and meat. LMB on a piece of food that can be cut into pieces and click LMB"
fields.Info: Used to cut certain items, such as Fish into separate pieces

fields.Description: "How to use: Hold LMB - start placing a wall Release LMB - finish placing RMB while holding LMB - cancel Shift+LMB - delete wall Shift while holding LMB - keep pivot relative"
fields.Info: RMB to change wall type. Places a semi transparent place for a wall to be, which can be filled with bricks, or alternatively dirt, recycled scrap, or player gibs (specifically "goregib_g_5"). Bricks can be purchased from the store in Brick stacks.

fields.Description: "How to use: RMB - fix the wall"
fields.Info: Despite the item description, LMB is actually the control to fix wall, Hold LMB to slowly fix a damaged wall from the Wall builder, or quickly tap LMB as fast as you can, allows for faster fix. Cannot fix a wall after it completely breaks.

fields.Description: "Does little damage but it has a huge speed"
fields.Info: Meant as a better tool to kill roaches with its fast swing rate. Does ZERO damage to props.

fields.Description: "Shoots nails. Put nails in a container box for nailgun to use them."
fields.Info: Shoots nails from the inventory at high speeds. To use, nails must be inside the player inventory. They can also be inside a container within the inventory.

fields.Description: "Converts objects into points. Should be used in case if you move saves and want to get a portion of points from large objects, or if you want to sell "large" objects like tables or printer."
fields.Info: Will turn objects into a number of floating coins which must be manually picked up. Amount of coins depends on sell price. Good for large objects that can't be shipped via item box.

fields.Description: "A small handheld pressure washer. LMB to shoot, RMB to gather water from the water source"
fields.Info: A pressure washer that shoots jets of water. Can push items as well as clean stains. Stores 10 right clicks' worth of water.

fields.Description: "Allows to remotely control the TV LMB on a TV to bind the TV RMB to call the TV"
fields.Info: Before 0.8.1, the TV remote could use almost any item, not just TVs.

fields.Description: "Can be used to disassemble large props. The object can be disassembled if: the object is heavy (means player can collide with it), if its made out of metal/wood/plastic/electronics, if it is NOT static"
fields.Info: Using the Hacksaw on a vending machine will cause an explosion. The vending machine will also drop a few of its snacks or sodas in addition to the electronic scrap.

fields.Description: "A tool used to create patches of land for farming, an alternative to the shovel
fields.Info: Patches dug by the rake function the same way as holes dug by the shovel. Digging using the rake will not produce dirt piles, unlike the shovel. Stepping on the rake causes it to flip up and ragdoll the player. If Player physics damage is enabled, this also deals about 5 points of damage to the player.

fields.Description: "An upgraded version of the digital camera, saves the digital copy of the photo and prints the physical copy right on the spot. Requires paper sheets"
fields.Info: When a photo is taken, it will replace one paper sheet in the player's inventory with the photo. If no paper is available, the picture will still be sent to the computer, meaning it functions the same way as the normal Digital camera.

fields.Description: "A coffee machine, uses coffee beans to make coffee."
fields.Info: Place a coffee bag on top to fill it with coffee beans. Place a paper cup and use the machine to make coffee. Very helpful to spend time awake. Cannot be picked up. Requires outlet.

fields.Description: "Objective: Shoot them"
fields.Info: A Space Invaders-like game arcade machine. Has the name "Attackers" on the sides, and "Andromeda Robotics" on the top. Interact to play, Enter to start, arrow keys to control. Cannot be picked up.

fields.Description: "TV can play video files from the Asset folder, or use online.txt to play video files from the link (should be direct link to a video file (youtube links does't work)) Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled!"
fields.Info: Place MP4 files in %localappdata%/VotV/Assets/tv. Refer to the Help menu "How to use tv" for more info.

fields.Description: "A huge plasma tv, can be attached to the wall (see Help section for more information about the TV) Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled!"
fields.Info: "Place MP4 files in %localappdata%/VotV/Assets/tv. Refer to the Help menu "How to use tv" for more info."

fields.Description: "A heavy medium sized TV (see Help section for more info about the TV) Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled!"
fields.Info: Each Medium TV purchased has an estimated 1/12 (8.33%) chance of being the Keljoy-themed variant instead of the default black version.

fields.Description: "beheaded Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled!"
fields.Info: Unlocked by earning the Achievement "SHES ALIVE"

fields.Description: "Radio can play audio files from the Asset folder, or use online.txt to play audio files from the link (should be direct link to a video file)"
fields.Info: Place MP3 files in %localappdata%/VotV/Assets/radio and use them in the radio. A volume slider and loop/stack/shuffle options are available. Refer to the Help menu "How to use radio" for more info.

fields.Description: "Fax can print photos taken from the digital camera. To print the photo go to PC > Photos > And press on a Gray button next to the photo slot"
fields.Info: Used for printing photos captured with the digital camera by using the Main Computer .

fields.Description: "A powerful and heavy microwave, can heat up and cook food. Be careful not to burn your food. DO NOT put anything suspicious inside the microwave"
fields.Info: Used for heating up food items to enhance the saturation effects. Cannot be picked up. Requires outlet.

fields.Description: "Hot plate can cook food more safely than fire or a microwave. Plug it into the electric socket, turn it on and put a piece of food on top that can be cooked"
fields.Info: Used for cooking food. Press the red switch to turn it on. Turn the dial to set its temperature. Requires outlet.

fields.Description: "Battery charger charges up accumulator batteries. Uses electric cord."
fields.Info: Charges accumulator batteries while plugged in. Allows for simultaneous charging of up to four batteries. Charges slower with more batteries slotted in. Requires outlet.

fields.Description: A small desktop 3D printer, can print 3D objects sourced from Assets folder.
A smoke detector, can be attached to a wall, emits a loud noise if there is a fire nearby
fields.Info: Does not require electricity

fields.Description: "A broomba. Your own little robot waifu, now in pancake shape! Rolls around the floor collecting trash and small items. Make sure to empty it ever so often, as it doesn't store infinite trash, unlike a certain skeleton."
fields.Info: Rolls around the ground and picks up small items, such as trash. Needs to be emptied of trash to allow it to continue. Does not affect Trash piles.

fields.Description: "Remote dron is equipped with a camera, can be controlled from the computer"
fields.Info: While activated, use the Cameras menu on the computer to pilot it. Turns using the middle slider, goes forward or backward using the bottom slider, and goes up and down using the right slider. Has limited power, which is charged using an outlet. Not battery compatible.

fields.Description: ""Kerfur" is a robot helper, follows you around, makes you company, can fix satellite servers."
fields.Info: A cat-like robot which can be activated and used to go out and fix servers. When used, will scan the map for any broken servers, and will return and follow the player when no servers are found broken. Can be controlled with the Cameras menu. Recharged with outlet. Cannot be picked up.

fields.Description: "Woodchipper destroys small and medium sized items, producing piles of chipped material. Uses fuel (LMB with a gas can on a fuel tank)"
fields.Info: Press the blue button on the back to turn it on. Place a chippable item on the big funnel to chip it. Releases trash piles of the corresponding chipped item through the smaller funnel. Cannot be picked up.

fields.Description: "A large 3D printer, can print 3D objects sourced from Assets folder. Max object size: 200x200x300 units"
fields.Info: Place meshes and textures of the same name in %localappdata%/VotV/Assets/meshes/printer. Use it in the printer menu in-game to start printing the model. Refer to the Help menu "How to upload printer models" for more info. Cannot be picked up.

fields.Description: "Frame uses GPU slots, GPU boards and coolers to generate points"
fields.Info: Slowly makes points. Makes points faster with more GPU boards and coolers slotted in. May overheat and explode without enough Coolers. Cannot be picked up. Requires outlet.

fields.Description: "Portable mini TV, wireless and small Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled! See "Hints and Tips" for more information.""
fields.Info: The smallest TV in the game, does not require electricity to work.

fields.Description: "UV light provides the necessary light for plants and makes them grow indoors or during the night."
fields.Info: Functions as sunlight for plants. Plants need to be illuminated from two sides to grow. Needs to be plugged in to work.

fields.Description: "A compact, portable, but less powerful version of the kitchen oven. Keeps the food temperature stable, preventing fires unlike the microwave."
"Portable PC has almost the same functionality as the main PC, allows to use most of the dekstop functions remotely. Limitations: No remote audio support Main PC must be on"

fields.Info: Used to charge car batteries for the ATV. To use, plug the charger in, grab the battery and place it in front of the charger so the colors match. If they don't, the battery will explode.

fields.Description: "Wooden barrel, can fit decent amount of items inside"
fields.Info: Cannot be picked up.

fields.Description: "Wooden barrel, can fit medium amount of items inside"
fields.Info: Cannot be picked up.

fields.Description: "An equippable backpack with a large amount of space inside."
fields.Info: The only equippable storage item.

fields.Description: "A drive rack. Can fit up to 16 drives."
fields.Info: Drives are placed by moving the Drive close enough to one of the Drive rack's slots. The player can also view the individual Drives' specs and LEDs while in the Drive rack.

fields.Description: "A heavy metallic bedside table. Fits not much inside itself but its quite heavy and solid"
fields.Info: A metal bedside table.

fields.Description: "Can store up to 20 discs."
fields.Info: Discs or Server Kits are placed by moving the Server Kit close enough to the pole of the Disc Box. The player can only access the top Server Kit in the stack. After 0.9 update, disc and disc box were replace by floppy disc and floppy disc box.

fields.Description: "Cardboard box can fit items inside it depends on box volume"
fields.Info: All cardboard boxes can be picked up.

fields.Description: "Medium wooden bedside table, can fit normal amount of stuff inside"
fields.Info: A wooden bedside table.

fields.Description: "A big 125x40x250cm heavy bookshelf, stores books and items like an ordinary bookshelf"
fields.Info: Bookshelves are purely decorative in terms of special function.

fields.Description: "A medium sized wooden drawer, can fit decent amount of items inside"
"Aa very big 120x75x240 cm wardrobe, can fit huge amount of items inside"
"Minifridge can store decent amount of items inside it, prevents the food from spoiling"
fields.Info: Cannot be picked up.

fields.Description: "Acts as an Open Container (see Help secction "Open container")"
fields.Info: Instead of having an inventory, Open Containers hold objects placed physically inside of them. The items will stick in place, so the container can be moved without causing them to fall out.

fields.Description: "Upgrades max inventoy space"
fields.Info: It can not be used as a normal storage object, instead expanding the player's inventory space directly. Multiple can be equipped at once. Each fanny pack equipped adds 250.0 volume to the player's maximum inventory space. Wearing 8 results in a total of 2,500.0 volume. If a fanny pack being unequipped causes the player's inventory to be overfilled, some items will be instantly dropped to make space. Because the fanny pack can not store items on its own, it is allowed to be sent through the Mailbox.

fields.Description: "A large heavy container on wheels. Acts as an Open Container (see Help secction "Open container")"
fields.Info: Instead of having an inventory, Open Containers hold objects placed physically inside of them. The items will stick in place, so the container can be moved without causing them to fall out.

fields.Description: A digital clock. Helps to track time and days.
fields.Info: Found in the computer room and the bedroom of the Alpha Root Base .

fields.Description: Regular curtains, blocks view with piece of cloth
fields.Info: Does not collide with the player. Found throughout the main Base. Curtains found in the base cannot be sold.

fields.Description: Big 2x2 wooden pallet
fields.Info: Does not collide with the player.

fields.Description: Big 2x2 wooden pallet Can be stepped on. Warning: unstable physics behavior, may launch the player after being stepped on.
fields.Info: Collides with the player, can be walked on.

fields.Description: ITS HIM!
fields.Info: Does not collide with the player.

fields.Description: A vase with feet.
fields.Info: Does not collide with the player.

fields.Description: A soccer ball, bouncy and fun.
fields.Info: Does not collide with the player. Can not be kicked as a result.

fields.Description: A wooden chair, can be sit on
fields.Info: Does not collide with the player, can be sat on.

fields.Description: A pet rock. Makes for good company in these trying times.
fields.Info: Does not collide with the player.

fields.Description: Default rug, adapts over the uneven terrain. Use to place the rug
fields.Info: 13 different variants with different shapes and colors.

fields.Description: Custom rug, uses images from Asset folder. Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled! See "Hints and Tips" for more information.
fields.Info: Uses same in-game information and stacks with Red (Long Red), but has a different model when placed.

fields.Description: Spotlight on a metal tripod, can be turned on and off, moved up and down, lits [ sic ] a huge area
fields.Info: Comes with head attached to tripod, for a standing spotlight. Spotlight cannot be separated from the tripod.

fields.Description: Spotlight head, very bright and powerful.
fields.Info: Only the head of the spotlight, for more maneuverability in placement. Intended for more specific circumstances than the tripod.

fields.Description: "Vargskelethor Joel" award plushie. Thank you for your great streams!
fields.Info: Emits a sound effect saying "Too many mushrooms" when used.

fields.Description: "IGP" award plushie. The legend. Pushed Voices of the Void to the masses.
fields.Info: Emits a roaring sound effect when held, placed, or used.

fields.Description: "Spazmatic Banana" award plushie.
fields.Info: Made by NutmegRaccoon.

fields.Description: A glowstick that can be stuck to multiple surfaces or objects.
fields.Info: 7 variants: white, red, green, blue, cyan, yellow, magenta.

fields.Description: A horizontal picture. Can be hung on a wall. Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled! See "Hints and Tips" for more information.
fields.Info: Put a PNG in the appropriate folder of %localappdata%/VotV/Assets/paintings to apply it to a painting. See "How to set custom pictures" in the Help menu for more info.

fields.Description: A square picture. Can be hung on a wall. Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled! See "Hints and Tips" for more information.
A vertical picture. Can be hung on a wall. Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled! See "Hints and Tips" for more information.
A small picture. Can be put on a table. Requires [Custom Content] setting enabled! See "Hints and Tips" for more information.
Metallic blue shelf
fields.Info: High center of gravity, topples easily.

fields.Description: A basketball hoop, another fun activity.
fields.Info: Attaches to the wall.

fields.Description: Generic looking gray alien. This is not how they look like, I know it.
A pack of balloons. Balloons can be attached to nails only.
fields.Info: Left click on a nailed down nail to use.

fields.Description: A wooden plank, quite resistant, can be useful to board things up in a pinch.
Regular curtains, blocks view with piece of cloth
fields.Info: Does not collide with the player. Found throughout the main Base. Curtains found in the base cannot be sold.

fields.Description: An old sheet of metal. These guys are selling you trash now huh.
Custom flag, supports custom images.
fields.Info: Put a PNG in the appropriate folder of %localappdata%/VotV/Assets/flags to apply it to a flag.

fields.Description: Put a PNG in the appropriate folder of %localappdata%/VotV/Assets/flags to apply it to a flag. Seems to have swapped cart sizes with its large counterpart.
Put a PNG in the appropriate folder of %localappdata%/VotV/Assets/flags to apply it to a flag. Seems to have swapped cart sizes with its medium counterpart.
An ordinary decoration.
fields.Info: Does not collide with the player.

fields.Description: An ordinary decoration.
